episodes.title: Je bosse pour elle
episodes.summary: As she vows to avenge her family after her birthday ends in bloodshed, Lyna edges closer to the one person she holds responsible: the Fury.

episodes.title: Cœur brisé > balle dans la tête
episodes.summary: With a police officer hot on her tail, Lyna's first mission sees her go deep undercover in Mama's bordello where a simple task turns very complicated.

episodes.title: J'aurai jamais parié sur toi
episodes.summary: The Fury races to retrieve a missing safe ahead of the Writing Ceremony. Dynamics shift as Lyna grapples with disturbing news about her parents.

episodes.title: La Furie, c'est comme la gale
episodes.summary: As Parques' ambitions come to the fore, the Fury turns to Fehim for support. Not knowing whom she can trust, Lyna looks for her own form of back-up.

episodes.title: Bonjour mon amour
episodes.summary: A prison visit results in a major encounter for Lyna, but her search for answers leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.

episodes.title: La nature a horreur du vide
episodes.summary: Lyna tries to predict the masked attacker's next move but patience is wearing thin. Her desperation leads to a last ditch attempt to restore order.

episodes.title: Ils sont où les couteaux ?
episodes.summary: In the creeping shadows of a hostile forest, an unlikely alliance is formed as common enemies circle close, poised to swoop in for the kill.

episodes.title: Namaste connard
episodes.summary: A hazardous train ride brings the Arago family saga to an explosive conclusion. Yet when old lies are covered up with new ones, the rot still lingers.

episodes.title: Toujours à sauver les chiens perdus.
episodes.summary: With a new order in charge of the underworld, the Furies turn to unlikely allies to help eliminate the organisation and take down its shadowy leader.

episodes.title: Comment on arrête un fourgon blindé ?
episodes.summary: When an extraction mission attracts unwanted guests, Lyna struggles to keep her link with Elie a secret. Selma pays a visit to her old foe, The Carny.

episodes.title: T'as loupé l’affaire du siècle !
episodes.summary: With news that Oz is coming to town, the crew devises a plan of attack. Lyna vies for Varda's trust, while Selma targets a Damocles weapons delivery.

episodes.title: Une trêve
episodes.summary: The Furies' ploy sends Selma on the run, holed up by The Carny. As Lyna gains unprecedented access to Damocles, she's forced to face off with Orso.

episodes.title: Le mensonge
episodes.summary: As Lyna races through Paris, Selma makes her intentions clear about Oz — and anyone who stands in her way. A suspicious Elie places his trust in Iris.

episodes.title: Je pourrai toujours te tuer demain.
episodes.summary: A grand plan unfolds as old allegiances crumble and unlikely bonds form. Refusing to accept the new order, Lyna prepares for one last fight.
